relations.quote: You have mended the play to fit the player. It is against nature.

story.body: You stood for the paste. Garnish called the mend against nature. You priced it as cheaper than a new player. The cue's end was the plain one from the night page. The morning stayed a rehearsal. Nobody was summoned to a play.

relations.quote: You have mended the play to fit the player. It is against nature.

title: Let Garnish paste the slip and called it cheaper than a new player
